register_entry.attempt_title: BSGS-Diagonal GPU per face search cifrata

entries.consolidation: Esito circoscritto e seguito collegati alle fonti nella scheda individuale.

reconciliation.title: BSGS-Diagonal GPU per face search cifrata
reconciliation.outcome: Il negativo CPU iniziale è stato seguito da una correzione documentata di padding e riuso della cache, con controlli zero-match N64/N128 corretti. I successivi run di identificazione privata passano genuine e reject a N64 e genuine a N128 su vettori sintetici: sono prove CPU circoscritte, senza replica GPU o confronto biometrico matched.
reconciliation.evidence_level: Osservazione iniziale, correzione documentata e successive prove funzionali CPU
reconciliation.successor: Il report FastHE/OpenFHE private BSGS conserva patch, input deterministici, hash e comandi FastHE; il limite di provenienza dell’osservazione iniziale non descrive tutto il ramo. Il reject N128 integrato resta distinto dal controllo del solo selettore.

sources.excerpt:
Nel solo caso N=128 la somma decifrata dell'indicatore approssimato era 5,50882. Per quel caso il
codice somma fino al batch CKKS da 16.384 slot, includendo 16.256 slot di padding. Una modifica
diagnostica `EvalSum(..., numVectors)` ha corretto N=128 mantenendo gli otto positivi, ma non e'
la release e non e' stata validata su un protocollo DIR@FPIR. Per N=1.024 non sono stati
preservati un aggregato decifrato equivalente o la stessa diagnosi causale. Inoltre, la mancata
isolazione di `--keep-serial` e l'assenza degli input/log grezzi nel repository impediscono di
attribuire entrambi i fallimenti al solo padding. Il generatore ufficiale rifiuta K=0, quindi
l'harness standard non copre il negativo.

## End-to-end results

All integrated runs used a fresh directory, 16 OpenMP threads, no serialized key/database cache, and deterministic orthogonal plumbing vectors. `response_ciphertexts=1` is the actual response; the encrypted max was not decrypted on the integrated path.

| Gallery/case | Decrypted scalar → decision | BSGS score | Private select | Client decrypt | Switch-key gen | DB enroll | Whole process | Maximum RSS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| N=64 genuine, target 37 | `37.009339 → 37`, accept 37, correct | 15.6687 s | 66.9932 s | 0.0119 s | 39.6896 s | 5.5849 s | 133.43 s | 13.873 GiB |
| N=64 zero match | `63.982989 → 64`, reject, correct | 15.3875 s | 60.6425 s | 0.0089 s | 32.5767 s | 4.8113 s | 117.65 s | 16.269 GiB |
| N=128 genuine, target 73 | `73.050423 → 73`, accept 73, correct | 15.6291 s | 101.9872 s | 0.0175 s | 38.6267 s | 4.6404 s | 164.95 s | 17.117 GiB |

The bounded integrated `N=128` run was stopped after one successful genuine case, by design. The selector alone was separately validated at `N=128` for both branches under the same 128-bit CKKS/FHEW settings:

| Selector-only case | Encrypted scalar → decision | Selection | Switch-key gen | Maximum RSS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| genuine, target 67 | `67.050803 → 67`, accept, correct | 123.5350 s | 49.7094 s | 9.152 GiB |
| zero match | `127.980695 → 128`, reject, correct | 113.9970 s | 36.9864 s | 9.785 GiB |

The selector-only cases encrypt a prepared packed score/sentinel vector. They validate the private selection/rejection mechanism but are not substitutes for the integrated BSGS run.

reconciliation.title: Trattare lo stato torus `-1` come messaggio positivo 15 nella LUT
reconciliation.outcome: La prima LUT interpretava male −Delta e rifiutava tutti gli accept su cinque chiavi: nella metà negaciclica si ottiene −f(15). La correzione f(15)=−1 ha fatto passare gli stessi cinque key-run e i replay.
reconciliation.evidence_level: controesempio FHE riprodotto e correzione verificata
reconciliation.successor: Correzione assorbita nel percorso A25; il negativo resta prova che l’aritmetica modulo 16 da sola è insufficiente.

sources.excerpt: La prima variante dello stato alternato rifiutava deterministicamente tutti gli accept su cinque chiavi: il valore fisico `-Delta` entra nella meta' negaciclica, quindi produce `-f(15)`, non `f(15)`. La LUT corretta memorizza `f(15)=-1` (`u64::MAX`) e ottiene un Booleano `+1`; dopo la correzione gli stessi cinque key-run e i replay cifrati passano. Questo controesempio impedisce di giustificare il circuito con la sola aritmetica modulo 16.

sources.excerpt:
The tournament comparison is not a unary 12-bit LUT. It consumes *two* 12-bit
scores, hence six base-16 digits and a 24-bit domain:

| mapping | input digits | domain | packed leading test polynomials | plaintext bytes lower bound |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| two 4-bit nibbles -> comparison state | 2 | 256 | 16 | 256 KiB |
| one 12-bit score -> three digits | 3 | 4,096 | 256 | 4 MiB |
| two 12-bit scores -> comparison state | 6 | 16,777,216 | 1,048,576 | 16 GiB |
| two scores plus two dynamic 8-bit IDs -> selected tuple | 10 | 2^40 | 2^36 | 1 PiB |

The byte column is deliberately a lower bound: it counts only one 64-bit
coefficient vector per horizontally packed test polynomial at `N=2048`. It
excludes ciphertext expansion, NTT/RNS multiplicity, keys, scratch memory, and
concurrent live levels.

A nibble comparator has the only small direct shape (`l=2`, 16 leading
polynomials). But a 12-bit lexicographic comparator needs state propagation:
after the first nibble pair, each following step consumes state plus two more
nibbles, returning to a 12-bit multi-input LUT. The paper's closest published
8-to-8 call is 0.63 seconds, while the complete local selection stage across all

La riduzione strutturale dei blind rotation, `692/4.965 = 13,938%`, differisce dalla riduzione di

corrispondenza e' coerente con i blind rotation come costo dominante nel confronto A29/A33; non
dimostra pero' una legge lineare trasferibile ad altri circuiti, macchine o livelli di parallelismo.

## Accordo semantico exact-ID

Le 120 coppie misurate e le 24 di warm-up escluse dalla statistica temporale producono **zero
discrepanze semantiche**. Entrambe le implementazioni restituiscono sempre un solo LWE col contratto
`exact-open-set-id-v2`: `0` rifiuta, mentre `i+1` identifica la prima identita' col minimo accettato.

sources.excerpt:
The ideal clear circuit is exact: it returns zero for all-reject and otherwise
the first one-based identity, including ties and gallery tails through N=128.
All immediate linear input bounds are at most five.  However, the proposed
single-accumulator dual decoder is not realizable for a full block.  Block zero
has thirteen reachable states (inactive plus IDs 1..12), thirteen distinct low
nibbles, and a high nibble fixed to zero.  Two translated 13-element sample
sets over the sixteen anti-periodic coefficient orbits overlap at least ten
times, while only the coefficient carrying low zero can satisfy a high-zero
overlap.  Exact enumeration also finds no box-aligned second extraction degree.

Two independent p=16 decoder LUTs are valid and keep every noise L1 bound at or
below five, but they cost two blind rotations per block.  They can reuse the
same key-switched input, so the fallback keeps the nominal KS count.  At N=127
it has the same BR count as the existing A34 two-nibble path while reducing KS
and output marginals.  The nominal one-BR counts are reported only as an
unrealizable counterfactual.  This model executes no FHE and makes no p-fail or
latency claim.

This is deliberately *not* an implementation candidate yet.  The direct input
has fresh-output linear L1 weight 14, above the parameter set's conservative
``max_noise_level=5``.  An exhaustive integer-coefficient collision search
proves that any scalar linear encoding capable of separating the four priority
classes has L1 weight at least 7.  Thus even the better unscaled/N/2 layout is
still outside that conservative bound.  This clear model performs no FHE and
makes no cryptographic failure-probability claim.

The production parameter set declares ``max_noise_level=5``.  Every input to an
OR node is a fresh Boolean at ``Delta_bool=2^59``; replacing radix four with
radix five therefore reaches, but does not exceed, the declared algebraic
limit.  The sign-based OR input is ``(1/2-s)*Delta_bool`` for ``s in 0..5`` and
retains a minimum decision margin of ``Delta_bool/2``.  Prefix expansion has at
most one fresh block prefix plus four fresh local flags.  One-hot A34 digit
reductions may sum five noisy ciphertexts, but their reachable plaintext stays
in ``0..15`` because at most one digit is nonzero.

This module checks clear OR/reduction/prefix semantics and recomputes exact
structural BR/KS/output-marginal counts for the frozen A33 output, the A34
base-8 candidate, and the A34 two-nibble candidate.  It does not modify those
implementations, run FHE, estimate latency, or promote the parameter set's
nominal per-PBS p-fail to an end-to-end bound.  The core_crypto path does not
carry the shortint NoiseLevel tracker, and shared-query/multi-output errors can
be correlated.

evidence.excerpt:
"""Clear/layout audit for a four-candidate A34 scan/output experiment.

The direct scalar encoding of four Boolean candidates needs L1 at least 15,
well above the frozen p=16 parameter's conservative ``max_noise_level=5``.
This model therefore evaluates a two-stage classifier.  The left pair is
bootstrapped to ``q in {0, 4, 8}``, then ``q + c2 + 2*c3`` has L1 four and the
reachable priority classes are::

    none {0}, fourth {2}, third {1, 3},
    second {4, 5, 6, 7}, first {8, 9, 10, 11}.

A full four-item group cannot extract both an injective local-first code and a
nonzero group flag from one scalar p=16 accumulator.  The blocker is stronger
than a search over box-aligned offsets: every one of the 2,048 possible second
extraction degrees is inconsistent when both outputs retain the standard
strict in-box radius of 63 coefficients.  Three-item tails are packable.

Global suppression itself is valid: local positions use even codes
``{0, 2, 4, 6, 8}`` and the prefix bit shifts them to the disjoint odd set.
However, a full group's low/high ID nibbles usually cannot share one scalar
selector accumulator either.  At N=127 only full group 3 and the final
three-item tail group 31 pack.  The realizable count therefore uses two blind
rotations sharing one key switch for every other dual-output operation.

This is a clear/count model only.  It does not run FHE, change the live A33
core, establish an end-to-end p-fail, or claim a latency improvement.

sources.excerpt:
Il raggruppamento diretto di tre flag signed in **un solo bit Booleano con un PBS `p=16` e'
impossibile** nel modello A33 corrente. Non e' pero' necessario tornare alle coppie: una rete a
due stadi, sempre a `Delta=2^59`, comprime fino a **15 template** in un Booleano canonico:

1. un PBS per tripla, con pesi `(1,3,9)`, produce il codice intermedio `31`, `0` oppure `1`;
2. un PBS somma fino a cinque codici intermedi e ne calcola l'OR.

Il modello clear passa tutti i controlli. A `N=127`, la sottorete A33
`pair canonicalizer -> compact OR` scende da **85 a 56 BR/KS/marginali**, cioe' risparmia

`4.273/3.892/4.908` a **`4.244/3.863/4.879`** BR/KS/marginali.

Questo e' un risultato clear e strutturale. Non e' stato compilato o eseguito codice FHE e non e'
una promozione del core.

  bounded esatto a 12 bit;
- ritorna `k` class labels cifrate e lascia la majority vote al client;
- non applica una soglia open-set al solo vincitore e non restituisce il
  contratto `0/ID`;
- il singolo BCS e' stabile, ma il top-k parallelo concatena i blocchi tramite
  [`par_bridge`](https://docs.rs/rayon/latest/rayon/iter/trait.ParallelBridge.html),
  che non garantisce l'ordine originario. Il first-tie globale
  non e' quindi un contratto dimostrato del sorgente fissato.

Verdetto: **NO-GO come drop-in di A38**. Rimane una pista condizionale per un
radix top-1 a tre nibble, ma prima servono tre stati digit esatti e ordinabili,
ordine dei blocchi deterministico, LUT/noise proof e gestione esplicita della
soglia.

reconciliation.outcome: Il run diagnostico del 5 settembre fallisce ancora: per x=0 il digit alto è 17 invece di 0, nonostante 7 test clear passati. La fase post-KS aveva già indirizzato la cella LUT sbagliata e il modulus switch peggiorava lo scarto; il PBS decodificava correttamente quella cella, quindi un cambio di decoder non ripara il componente.
reconciliation.evidence_level: FHE negativo e diagnosi aritmetica del trace
reconciliation.successor: Servono premesse di precisione/interfaccia che controllino KS e arrotondamento coefficientwise; A52 resta escluso dalla baseline qualificata.

sources.excerpt: Root's release tests passed7/7, including all three new clear regressions; release build passed. The fixed x=0 diagnostic then exited101 at the unchanged high assertion: child16568,13:41:56.432565→13:41:57.365251 UTC. The score-lane native result was0 as expected; high was17 versus expected0. There are exactly four stdout rows (SOURCE, KEY, INPUT, HIGH_DIAGNOSTIC), no fixture PASS and no summary. The old gate and this new recorded negative remain preserved; no retry occurred.

Independent read-only arithmetic review recomputed all emitted affine error fields, all879 coefficientwise mask degrees and the body degree, the degree composition, all2048 stock LUT words, negacyclic output at the actual degree and output decoding. Input error was inside the old scalar margin. The post-KS phase-only degree had already moved three positions below nominal and selected code17; coefficientwise rounding moved nine more positions below that. The actual PBS output correctly decoded the LUT at that displaced address, with residual below half the output spacing. Thus this sample's semantic failure was already present at the PBS input/address; it was not an erroneous final decode of the correctly addressed desired nibble. This does not assert a causal variance law or transfer the new trace back to the old key.

The required repair premise must address both pre-PBS KS error and coefficientwise modulus-switch rounding at the small input spacing. Changing the final decoder, assuming the tiny original input error survives KS/MS unchanged, or shifting the public offset cannot justify this component. No supported alternative parameter/interface has yet been established by this bounded diagnostic. A52 remains excluded from a correctness-qualified combined baseline until a separately justified intervention passes its actual interface gate.

reconciliation.outcome: Per i prototipi A38/A41/A44 esaminati, l’audit non ricava dalle sorgenti un bound composto non banale: i prodotti marginali×p richiedono premesse non dimostrate. La rimozione del decode stretto in A41 e il retune A44 non chiudono automaticamente il prefisso raw.

sources.excerpt:
I valori `4206 * 2^-71.625 = 2^-59.5868` per A38/A41 e
`4206 * 2^-64.088 = 2^-52.0498` per A44 restano calcoli di union bound **condizionati** a una
premessa non ancora dimostrata: ogni marginale prodotta dalle LUT e dalle estrazioni raw deve
ereditare il contratto `p-fail` del preset per il suo effettivo input, sotto un prefisso di calcolo
corretto.

| variante | cosa e' davvero chiuso | cosa resta aperto | bound E2E corrente |
|---|---|---|---:|
| A38 | conteggio strutturale `3655 BR / 3274 KS / 4206 marginali` | score/extraction/LUT raw e output finale stretto a `Delta=2^56` seguito da addizione | `<= 1` |
| A41 | il client riceve due radici p16 separate a `Delta=2^59`; il gap terminale di A38 e' rimosso, condizionatamente `2p <= 2^-70.625` | tutto il prefisso raw condiviso con A38 | `<= 1` |
| A44 | conserva l'uscita A41 e porta il preset a `max_noise_level=15` | nessuna prova che il ledger raw sia il `NoiseLevel` ufficiale; score iniziale Gaussian con supporto non limitato | `<= 1` |

La modifica minima che rende **corretta la frase di tesi oggi** e' chiamare i numeri `4206p`
“budget condizionale” e riportare come bound E2E solo `<=1`. Per ottenere un bound non banale con
le sole garanzie locali della libreria, la modifica minima del *perimetro di prova* e' mantenere la
semantica terminale A41, ma costruire un reference path interamente con ciphertext genuini e
operazioni checked delle API `integer`/`shortint`; poi si conta il suo vero numero `M` di output PBS
e si applica `M * 2^log2_p_fail`. Non basta avvolgere un `LweCiphertext` raw dichiarandolo
`NoiseLevel::NOMINAL`.

reconciliation.title: Riferimento exact-ID con sole API checked-shortint
reconciliation.outcome: Il design checked-shortint conserva 0/ID, primo tie e soglia del vincitore usando operazioni checked, con abort distinto da un’identità. È un riferimento statico deliberatamente costoso; le esecuzioni successive appartengono ad A68.
reconciliation.evidence_level: design e modello clear del riferimento checked
reconciliation.successor: A68 lo implementa; A72 compila e i successivi run N1/N2 completano fixture FHE limitate.

sources.excerpt:
A64 is a deliberately slow, auditable reference path for the same observable result as A41/A44:

```text
0      = reject
i + 1  = exact nearest gallery identity
ties   = first gallery position
gate   = threshold belonging to that global winner
```

It needs **no custom raw LWE, no `core_crypto` call, no `ManyLUT`, and no manual noise
metadata**.  Every encrypted Boolean operation is a one-block `RadixCiphertext` call to
`ServerKey::{checked_bitand, checked_bitor, checked_bitxor}`.  A checked failure aborts the
request and denies access; it is never converted into an identity.

This directory is a **static reference design**, not a performance result.  No Cargo build, key
generation, Docker command, FHE evaluation, or network access was run for A64.  The executable
artifact is a pure-clear semantic/count model plus tests and source pins.

| A68 checked-shortint reference, N2 | PASS; ID2,61,995 checked calls≤61,997 bound;1000.482180s | Reused pinned A72 binary, one zero query, templates e0/zero and threshold0. Exercises a noninitial winner and acceptance. Checked API calls are not PBS counts; no broader domain or latency qualification. |

reconciliation.title: Parallelismo dello scan e riuso degli accumulatori A62
reconciliation.outcome: A66 conserva il grafo A62 e cambia preparazione degli accumulatori e parallelismo dello scan. Il successivo paired A73 conferma output byte-identici: a 16 thread migliora del 22,2018%, mentre a un thread peggiora del 2,2628% nel campione.
reconciliation.evidence_level: audit statico e benchmark FHE appaiato
reconciliation.successor: A73 misura la modifica a thread fissati; A124 amplia lo studio dei thread senza cambiare retroattivamente questo confronto.

sources.excerpt:
Non emerge una divergenza bloccante della semantica exact-ID sul percorso valido. A66 conserva il
grafo logico A62, il primo vincitore nei tie, i contatori `3390/3009/3930` a N=127 e il wire a due
radici p16 base 15. Il cambiamento osservato e' limitato alla preparazione degli accumulatori A53,
alla schedulazione dei peer indipendenti e ai contatori atomici.

Il claim strutturale e' corretto ma va formulato precisamente: **nel solo adapter A53**, a N=127,
A62 costruisce 136 GLWE triviali e A66 ne prepara 35. Sono 101 costruzioni in meno (-74,3%), non
101 PBS in meno, non un risparmio dimostrato di latenza e non una riduzione delle allocazioni
dell'intera query.

Il confronto combina sei blocchi con chiavi fresche e 120 coppie misurate per ciascuno strato
di thread: 240 coppie incluse nell'analisi e 48 warm-up esclusi, tutti i 288 casi PASS. A62 e A66
ricevono in ogni coppia lo stesso ciphertext, la stessa chiave server e la
stessa galleria. Entrambe le varianti restituiscono l'esatto codice `0/ID`, con contatori identici
`3390 BR / 3009 KS / 3930 marginali` e output ciphertext byte-identico in ogni coppia.

| thread | mediana A62 | mediana A66 | riduzione GM paired | CI95 gerarchico | vittorie A66 |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 46,685875 s | 48,098900 s | -2,2628% | [-3,0016%, -1,3313%] | 15/120 |
| 16 | 6,611002 s | **5,190636 s** | **22,2018%** | **[19,6143%, 24,1281%]** | **119/120** |

A un thread A66 perde il 2,26%; a 16 thread vince il 22,20%. Questo supporta l'interpretazione
causale prevista: A66 non accorcia il circuito, ma espone parallelismo e riusa gli accumulatori
della scan. Non autorizza a trasferire il vantaggio ad altri host o numeri di thread.

The driver is PID 18737; child PID 18740 is identical in the child and terminal records. The child exited 0, from 2026-09-05 12:05:14.443688 to 12:13:48.672915 UTC, a recorded elapsed interval of 514.229227 seconds (8m34s). Thus the actual 43,013 successful checked calls equal the independently predicted fixture count and satisfy the enforced upper bound. The terminal line follows successful output-bit checks and ID equality, not merely completion of the encrypted loop.

The captured prepared/child/wait-complete records agree on the executable, cwd and arguments `--run --case=small --small-n=2`, with eight requested Rayon threads. Child91863 exits0,13:18:07.178721→13:34:47.660901UTC, elapsed1000.482180s. Stderr is empty. Stdout has exactly the three expected lines, ending `PASS: ID=2, checked calls=61995, ledger upper bound=61997`; its SHA256 is `81c28dd9805577370415e25683b7644b6438948a155b80330e19f75214ff4a88`. reconciliation.outcome: Il report A73 richiama «l’audit statico A70» per il tie-first, precisando che lo smoke non contiene un tie. È disponibile anche l’audit statico A66 sull’ordine indicizzato, ma il richiamo non dimostra che quel file coincida con il manufatto denominato A70.

sources.excerpt:
Il run a 16 thread ha inoltre completato senza panic, data race osservabile o riordinamento
dell'output. Questo e il type-check confermano che le condivisioni raw usate da questa fixture sono
accettate dai bound `Send + Sync`; un singolo smoke non e' una prova generale di assenza di race.
Il probe non contiene un tie, quindi la regola tie-first non riceve nuova copertura runtime qui:
resta verificata dalla struttura indicizzata/raccolta ordinata e dall'audit statico A70.

1. `src/a53_scan.rs`, che definisce LUT, layout, radix 15 e modello clear, e' identico.
2. I candidati arrivano nello stesso ordine dal core A50 invariato.
3. Gli iteratori paralleli di slice sono indicizzati; i `Vec` raccolti conservano l'indice di
   galleria, non l'ordine di completamento dei thread.
4. Il prefix parallelo ricostruisce per ogni indice gli stessi `block_index`, `offset` e ingressi
   dell'algoritmo sequenziale A62. La ricorsione resta una barriera.
5. Ogni nodo somma i propri LWE nello stesso ordine sequenziale di A62; soltanto nodi indipendenti
   possono completare in ordine diverso.
6. Le riduzioni low/high conservano ordine dei chunk, livelli e forwarding dei singleton. Il
   `rayon::join` terminale separa due lane senza dipendenza reciproca.
7. Ogni selector possiede il layout dello stesso `group_index`; il relativo accumulatore viene
   mosso in un solo job e ruotato in-place.

Ne segue che prefix esclusivo, posizione locale e indice globale continuano a scegliere il primo
argmin ammesso. Il controllo statico composto A50+A53 conferma 512 fixture (reject, primo tie e
ultima identita' per ogni N=1..128), ma non sostituisce una replica FHE.

The canonical run used the fresh target directory
`tmp/a68-checked-shortint-rust-prototype/target-a72`.  Earlier exploratory outputs made through
the repository's shared target directory are deliberately non-canonical: another concurrent arm
showed that cloned crates can collide there.  The fresh target rebuilt TFHE-rs and A68 and its

sources.excerpt:
`PASS_CORRECTNESS_NO_MATERIAL_SCALAR_LATENCY_GAIN` / scalar integration gate `NO_GO`.

Reusing one `Fft` plan and one pre-sized `ComputationBuffers` removes the convenience wrappers'
per-call heap allocation deterministically, but it does not produce a measurable scalar latency
improvement on this host. Across the two uncontaminated runs, the reusable path is slightly slower
at the median for both a complete classic PBS and a blind rotation. The differences are below 1%
and should be treated as effectively neutral, not as a slowdown claim.

No A66 exact-ID source was changed and no full exact-ID integration was attempted. The smallest
next experiment justified by A77 would be a controlled parallel primitive benchmark with one
scratch buffer per worker. A77 alone does not justify adding that adapter to A66.

Run 01 ended at 20:56:18 +0200. A concurrent A73 N=127 process was observed by the coordinator
around this interval, so run 01 is preserved but excluded from performance conclusions. Its raw
JSON/time record and a diagnostic run01+run02 aggregate remain available.

Run 02 ended at 20:56:41 +0200, after the coordinator observed A73 exit. Before run 03, the process
check found no A73, A78, Cargo, rustc, or A77 process. The A78 worker also confirmed it stayed
source-only during run 03. Run 03 ended at 20:59:11 +0200. Therefore the canonical aggregate uses
only run 02 and run 03. This controls known project benchmark overlap, but it is still a host
microbenchmark rather than a laboratory-isolated performance claim.

Data: 3 settembre 2026. Stato: **protocollo statico preregistrato; nessun Cargo, rustc, keygen,
TFHE/FHE o benchmark e' stato eseguito da A85**. Non esiste ancora un claim di latenza A85.

## Risultato che questo esperimento deve separare

A77 ha gia' dimostrato una cosa positiva ma limitata: in modalita' scalare la API
`*_mem_optimized` elimina una allocazione/deallocazione di scratch per primitive (196.735 byte per
PBS completa, 163.967 per blind rotation), mantenendo output bit-identici, ma non migliora la
latenza scalare di almeno l'1%. A73 initial mostra invece che A66 porta la scan parallela nella
stessa fascia di throughput di extract/select; A80 raccomanda quindi di misurare il punto di
saturazione `1/2/4/6/8/12/16`, senza scambiare equivalenti PBS per core fisici.

A79 is an executable, source-locked symbolic audit model for the A62 exact-ID
path. It does **not** prove A62's end-to-end failure probability. Its current
unconditional result deliberately remains `P_fail <= 1`.

The status names intentionally say `PASS_DECLARATIVE_*`. A matching digest is
not execution attestation: the checker does not prove that the pinned binary
emitted the trace. The accumulator spec currently binds declarative metadata,
not the actual polynomial body or an independently evaluated LUT truth table.
Every runtime accumulator-to-map bridge therefore remains an explicit open
obligation.

The replay also covers only supplied nodes; the optimized Rust runtime does not
yet emit a complete 3390-BR trace. A coherent but invented trace can pass its
internal checks if it is paired with a correspondingly chosen manifest and

A93 corrects one composition contract without modifying frozen A84. A84's
polynomial bodies and joint truth tables remain valid: its evaluator samples
the raw body, adds the source-derived public offset, and obtains the expected
final identity digit. The defect is narrower. For 55 of 67 sample declarations
across 31 selector records, A84 put the **post-offset** reachable set into an
A79 `pbs` output field that represents the **raw pre-offset** sample.

correlati base 15 o la ricostruzione esatta dell'ID. Pero' rende concreta una strada ulteriore:
fare mapping del nostro DAG con un costo consapevole di profondita', parallelismo e runtime, invece
di scegliere ogni ottimizzazione soltanto dal conteggio totale dei PBS.

dominio discreto, output cifrato contenente soltanto `0/ID`, rifiuto open-set inclusivo, pareggio
deterministico al primo ID e server singolo non interattivo senza restituire il vettore dei punteggi.

La strada piu' direttamente implementabile resta il comparatore TFHE con payload cifrato di Cong
et al. (SAC 2024/ePrint 2023/852), cioe' la linea A30. La linea common-mask A78 e' complementare:
puo' comprimere PBS/priority-scan a valle, ma non sostituisce il comparatore dei punteggi e non e'
ancora promuovibile senza bridge e bound composto di rumore. BatchBoot/AmortBoot sono lead di
throughput da misurare sul totale della query; BoostCom e' una vera alternativa exact BGV da
prototipare **standalone**, non un bridge gratuito. Le linee CKKS trovate sono approssimate oppure
spostano la selezione su client/secondo server e quindi non sono la soluzione finale al requisito
attuale.

sources.excerpt:
A90 found a second, narrower composition defect without changing A84. For 55
of 67 samples across 31 selector records, A84's embedded
`a79_contract.samples[*].reachable_overapprox` is the set of final values after
the public offset. A79 v3 gives a `pbs` event's output ID to the raw value
immediately after BR/sample extraction and models a later public offset with a
separate `linear` event. The two sets are therefore not interchangeable.

For example, `a53.selector.g00.len4` degree 0 has public offset 2. Its embedded
A84 set is `[0,1,2,3,4]`, while the raw set is `[0,1,2,30,31]` modulo 32.
Degree 1024 has public offset 30: embedded `[0]`, raw `[2]`. This is not a body
or truth-table failure: A84's exact evaluator explicitly adds the offset and
gets the right final values. It is a stage error in the A84-to-A79 projection.

It then emits one explicit A79 `linear` event with coefficient 1 and the public
offset for each of the 64 selector samples. The real source-pinned A79-v3
parser and replay accept the corrected manifest and trace.

This is a static, declarative correction. It is not a production trace, FHE
run, binary attestation, or proof that the runtime applied an offset.

sources.excerpt:
A92 safely omits one of Chen packing's eight post-pack trace stages because its
current robust selector accepts a certified selector-control rotation-error
radius of `R=63`.  A95 derives the exact general rule for retaining still fewer
stages if a later, independent proof of the control LWE at blind-rotation
ingress establishes a smaller radius:

```text
robust cell width W = 2R + 1
required residual-support spacing S = least power of two >= W
retained trace stages t = log2(S)
N=127 EvalAuto total = 883 + 127t
```

The strict separation condition is `S > 2R`.  A partial trace leaves arbitrary
residual coefficients at multiples of `S`; the shared kernel spreads each by
`[-R,+R]`, while extraction may sample the target in that same interval.  Two
different cells therefore collide exactly when `S <= 2R`.

The current `R=63` row remains unchanged: `S=128`, seven retained trace stages,
14 EvalAuto operations per non-root node, eight at the root, and **1,772** at
`N=127`.

These are ideal phase/ring statements.  They do not prove the control-path
radius and do not model unsigned coefficient division, automorphism-key errors,
or joint four-output payload noise.

entries.consolidation: Esito circoscritto e seguito collegati alle fonti nella scheda individuale.

reconciliation.outcome: L’inverso modulare di N non esiste sul toro 2^64; le alternative con divisione iniziale o per gruppi hanno identità e limiti deterministici separati. La loro validità algebrica non implica che il rumore della composizione cifrata sia ammissibile.

sources.excerpt:
1. The literal CDKS preprocessing `N^-1 mod q` is a **NO-GO** here.  CDKS
   explicitly requires `gcd(q,N)=1`; for `q=2^64` and `N=2048`, the gcd is
   2048 and the inverse does not exist.
2. TFHEpp's current Chen code normalizes at every materialized stage using
   unsigned componentwise `/=2`.  A selected non-root payload crosses ten
   stages, but the whole packing DAG performs 14 recursive GLWE divisions plus
   seven trace divisions.  The root performs two plus seven.  A96 derives a
   deterministic normalization-only bound, conditional only on exact
   EvalAuto/stage algebra, and deliberately keeps EvalAuto error separate.
3. Dividing every input LWE once by `2^10=1024`, then running the arity-8 pack
   and seven trace stages without any intermediate division, restores the
   original scale exactly modulo `2^64`.  The root analog uses `2^8=256`.
   This is algebraically viable and has directly relevant prior art in Wang et
   al.; it is **not yet a noise-valid A92 implementation**.
4. Batching `g` stages at a time interpolates between those endpoints.  It can
   reduce coefficient traffic while capping amplification of an EvalAuto error
   inside a block at `2^(g-1)`.  The best static compromise depends on measured
   EvalAuto noise; A96 therefore records a falsifiable frontier instead of
   selecting a winner.
| A104 Chen packing | PASS: 60 cases / 15,240 tuples / 60,960 words | All 3 fixed fixtures × 4 parameters × 5 arms; no full selector/root composition |

**A92/A95–97/A99/A101–104/A111.** Chen packing combines encrypted scalar payloads into one polynomial using automorphisms, then removes unwanted coefficients. Partial trace keeps only the cleanup needed by the selector’s robust cells. Grouped division and MS-Pack change where rounding happens; a literal modular division by the power-of-two polynomial size is impossible in this torus.

sources.excerpt:
The useful new lead is not “replace 14 EvalAuto with fewer EvalAuto.” For an
eight-payload non-root selector, partial MS-PackLWEs still uses exactly the same
14 physical EvalAuto calls and the same ten automorphism degrees as A99:

```text
packing:       3,3,5,3,3,5,9       (seven calls, temporal order)
partial trace: 33,65,129,257,513,1025,2049
```

Lee–Yoon Algorithm 6 normalizes the difference only:

```text
D = E-X^s O
H(D) + Auto(H(D)) + X^s O.
```

Consequently the proposed partial-MS arm uses 14 logical rank-1 GLWE
normalizations per non-root node rather than A99 g1's 21. That is 57,344 rather
than 86,016 normalized `u64` words. This is an operation/traffic count, **not a
latency claim**. A99's experimental grouped `g2` arms touch only 36,872 words,
but their `/4` grouping does not inherit the MS-PackLWEs theorem.

MS-PackLWEs is established prior art. The A102 project-specific adaptation is
the combination with A92's omitted degree-17 trace stage, exact mixed-scale D2
slot map and width-127 isolation geometry. No novelty claim is made here.

For both GLWE polynomials this needs `2*(127 + 2*2047) = 8,442` wrapping word
updates, **61.62x fewer structurally**. Across 127 selector nodes the ledger is
66,064,384 versus 1,072,134 word updates. These are operation counts, not a

blind rotation, and the rest of exact-ID remain outside A103.

closed-form signed support, then compares the sliding and literal algorithms
on 32 deterministic arbitrary-u64 polynomials. Since the map is public and
linear, replacing the literal loop changes neither ciphertext noise nor the

Status: **useful adjacent systems result; NO-GO as an exact-ID selector**.
This note is a read-only literature classification. It contains no Cargo build,
key generation, FHE execution, benchmark, or transferred latency claim.

The paper is unusually relevant to this thesis because it evaluates encrypted
vector search, includes a face corpus, and discusses both flat and hierarchical
search. Its headline scale must nevertheless not be compared directly with the
local exact `0/ID` pipeline.

The local contract is a single-server, non-interactive, open-set identification
function over an ordered gallery:

```text
j   = first index attaining the global minimum score
out = j+1 if score[j] <= threshold[j], otherwise 0
```

Only encrypted `out` may leave the server. In particular, the client must not
receive the score vector and must not choose the branch or winner in clear.

sources.excerpt:
For base 16, one 12-bit score is three digits. An identity LUT over one score is
therefore the published `l=3` shape: 4,096 domain entries and, under horizontal
packing, 256 leading test polynomials. That is tractable as a table, though its
published 1.12-second call already assumes the three encrypted input digits are
available.

The tournament comparison is not a unary 12-bit LUT. It consumes *two* 12-bit
scores, hence six base-16 digits and a 24-bit domain:

| mapping | input digits | domain | packed leading test polynomials | plaintext bytes lower bound |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| two 4-bit nibbles -> comparison state | 2 | 256 | 16 | 256 KiB |
| one 12-bit score -> three digits | 3 | 4,096 | 256 | 4 MiB |
| two 12-bit scores -> comparison state | 6 | 16,777,216 | 1,048,576 | 16 GiB |
| two scores plus two dynamic 8-bit IDs -> selected tuple | 10 | 2^40 | 2^36 | 1 PiB |

The byte column is deliberately a lower bound: it counts only one 64-bit
coefficient vector per horizontally packed test polynomial at `N=2048`. It
excludes ciphertext expansion, NTT/RNS multiplicity, keys, scratch memory, and

## Verdict

- **Direct 24-bit LFBS comparator: no-go for the current frontier by table
  shape.** It remains exact, but its exponential domain defeats the purpose.
- **Unary 12-bit identity/digit extraction: not promoted.** The input already
  has to be digitized, and the published latency does not support replacing the
  full current extraction stage.

sources.excerpt:
**No direct binary-GINX speedup is established.** Bernard and Joye's method is
best understood as a **gap closer for arbitrary/Gaussian secret keys**: it makes
an AP/automorphism blind rotation approach the operation floor of binary GINX,
but does not go below that floor at fixed parameters.

The decisive invariant is simple. Every method in Table 5.4 performs exactly
`n` external products. An automorphism variant additionally performs a
non-negative number of automorphism key switches. Binary GINX at the same
`(n, N, k)` is the comparison case with `n` external products and no such
automorphism key switches. Even the most aggressive displayed variants retain
about 1.5 or 1.9 expected key switches; under the paper's transform-count model
they therefore remain slightly *above*, not below, same-parameter GINX.

Classification for this thesis:

- **No-go as a drop-in optimization:** replacing the current binary-key
  TFHE-rs GINX PBS solely to claim lower latency.
- **Deferred whole-stack alternative:** retuning parameters/security/noise for
  an arbitrary or Gaussian *secret-key* distribution. Such retuning can change
  `n` and `N`, so the fixed-parameter inequality does not prove a universal
  impossibility; the paper does not provide evidence that this route beats our
  binary-key PBS under the same application and security contract.

A120 preserves the A108 cryptographic datapath and semantic fixtures, but moves
the requested offsets to `-48`, `0`, and `+48`. The maximum requested absolute
offset is therefore 15 blind-rotation degrees inside the certified boundary:

```text
certified support:      -63 -------------------------------- +63
requested A120 points:        -48 ------------ 0 -------- +48
guard band:              15 degrees                      15 degrees
```

The 15-degree margin is an experimental isolation choice, **not** a theorem or
probabilistic bound on post-key-switch noise. Runtime classification always uses
the actual decrypted post-key-switch phase after the same TFHE-rs modulus switch;
it never trusts the requested offset alone.
| A120 PFKS interior margins | PASS: 24 cases / 3 generation processes | Phase-based support observer does not record actual coefficientwise BR address; key IDs absent |

## New support-audit correction

A120 classified support using `round(decrypted post-KS phase)`. Stock blind rotation instead
uses `round(body) - sum(round(mask_i)*secret_i)` modulo 4096. They can differ due to modulus-switch
rounding: two half-degree masks under secret [1,1] and their exact sum as body have phase zero
but effective rotation degree -1. A127 records both quantities and gates on the exact effective
degree, using the same upstream `pbs_modulus_switch` called by the stock blind rotation.

The pinned TFHE-rs PFPKS key generator already accepts an arbitrary plaintext
polynomial `P`.  Its linear contract is an encryption of `f(m) * P`.  A121 sets
`f` to the identity and sets `P` to the signed width-127 window centered at
zero.  Every payload therefore leaves PFPKS already spread over one robust
cell.  A cheap exact multiplication by a monic monomial moves that encrypted

control key switch, one blind rotation, and four sample extractions.

same entity dimensions and byte count as A108's constant-output PFPKS key; its
encrypted plaintext polynomial is different, so it is a distinct key and
cannot be substituted silently into A108.

directories.title_from_readme: A122 - direct-window PFPKS D1 delta selector

entries.consolidation: Esito circoscritto e seguito collegati alle fonti nella scheda individuale.

reconciliation.title: Selezione PFKS D1 su differenze e addizione finale
reconciliation.outcome: La costruzione seleziona right−left e aggiunge poi left, dimezzando da otto a quattro i PFKS per nodo a quattro payload nel modello esatto. Questo conto non dimostra una riduzione universale della varianza degli errori di chiave.
reconciliation.evidence_level: Algebra e conteggi statici
reconciliation.successor: A171/A174 passano il componente D1, A191 aggiunge il comparatore; la linea prosegue nelle composizioni PFKS e Head/PFKS.

sources.excerpt:
A121 removes A108's noisy post-PFPKS convolution but still private-functionally
key-switches all eight left/right payloads.  A122 applies the same direct-window
idea to the D1 delta identity already screened in A87.  For each of four tuple
lanes, form the big-LWE difference

```text
delta_j = right_j - left_j.
```

PFPKS each delta directly onto the width-127 base window, rotate the four GLWEs
to the four **right-control** lane centers, and add them.  After one encrypted
control rotation and four sample extractions, add the original left LWEs:

```text
control=left:   left_j + 0                 = left_j
control=right:  left_j + (right_j-left_j) = right_j.
```

All arithmetic is modulo the native 64-bit torus.  The ID limb keeps its own
`Delta=2^56`; the score limbs keep `Delta=2^59`.  The same selected tuple is
therefore available to the exact stable-first tournament and inclusive
threshold contract.

**A86–87/A108/A120–123/A127/A134/A137/A147/A151/A167/A171/A174/A186/A191.** PFKS converts payloads into an encrypted lookup table. Packing three score digits and one ID lets one choice rotation select all four. A108’s original spread-by-convolution construction failed every tested parameter point. Its phase-only observer could not prove actual coefficientwise rotation support, so “failure inside certified support” was an overstatement.

Direct-window keys put the desired window into the key-switch output itself. The later A137 three-process D2 gate passed all 24 fixtures; its scalar and convolution controls also passed that sample. D1 goes further: switch right-minus-left, then add left back. A174 passed the fixed 24-fixture progression; each D1 selector uses four PFKS, one ordinary KS, one BR and four samples versus eight PFKS for D2. A151 separately checked one real PFKS aggregate against independently observed key-row errors; that is an identity, not a tail estimate.

A191 closed the **supplied decision-bit** gap for one fixture: an actual four-PBS comparator fed the same control to D1, D2 and scalar selectors. Its 48-record gate passed; total diagnostic cost was 20 PFKS/10 KS/10 BR/16 samples.

The new result is stronger than counting 1016→8→4 intermediate GLWE coefficients:
the executable map retains the functional-key family, input row (including the
body), decomposition level and error-polynomial coefficient. It proves an exact
D2 coefficient-norm reduction, exposes cross-lane cancellation, and preserves a
counterexample to assuming that D1 always reduces key-error variance.

entries.consolidation: Esito circoscritto e seguito collegati alle fonti nella scheda individuale.

reconciliation.outcome: Kernel e generatore PFPKS sono byte-identici nelle due versioni esaminate; l’aggiornamento non costituisce una riparazione del negativo A108. L’identità delle sorgenti del kernel non prova identità dei tempi del programma completo.

sources.excerpt:
Upgrading the selector from TFHE-rs `0.11.3` to the locally available `1.7.0`
does not by itself change the private-functional packing key-switch algorithm:

| Pinned source | 0.11.3 vs 1.7.0 |
|---|---|
| `lwe_private_functional_packing_keyswitch.rs` | byte-identical |
| `lwe_private_functional_packing_keyswitch_key_generation.rs` | byte-identical |
| PFPKS entity implementation | same geometry/API surface; one 20-line formatting/API-style diff in a container divisibility assertion |

Both versions therefore decompose the same LWE coefficients, perform the same
scalar multiply/subtract accumulation, and generate the functional key from
the same scalar function and plaintext polynomial.  A version bump cannot be
claimed as a correctness fix for A108's convolution noise, and it does not make
A121/A122's direct-window idea unnecessary.

This does **not** prove identical executable performance: the compiler,
dependency graph, surrounding key creation, allocator, FFT implementation, and
parameter plumbing may differ.  A same-parameter paired 1.7 benchmark remains
reasonable only after a candidate passes correctness on 0.11.3.  Python version
changes affect the static audit harness, not these Rust cryptographic kernels.

The new route is **M: Head Start, five-payload PFKS tournament, split 3+2,
base 22 and public mean correction**, using TFHE-rs 1.7.0, A44 Gaussian parameters
and Standard modulus switching. It returns the minimum-score identity if that
score meets the inclusive threshold, choosing the earliest ID for ties, and 0
otherwise. The output is two encrypted base-15 digits.

A121's direct-window D2 construction is now materialized against the unchanged A108/A120
convolution and scalar D2 datapaths. All arms receive identical noisy input LWEs, A44 base keys,
KSK and BSK. The direct-window and constant-polynomial functional keys are distinct, independently
encrypted keys under the same secrets. That distinction is explicit; they cannot be identical
because their encoded linear functions differ.

The new key uses `f(x)=x` and A121's signed width-127 polynomial centered at zero. Eight PFKS
outputs undergo exact monomial rotations to the left/right cells, seven additions, one KS,
one blind rotation and four extractions. No post-PFKS FFT/public-mask convolution occurs.
The unchanged reference key uses the A108 combination `f(x)=-x`, polynomial `-1`, whose product
also represents the identity. No secret-key operation occurs before all three server-arm timers

## New support-audit correction

A120 classified support using `round(decrypted post-KS phase)`. Stock blind rotation instead
uses `round(body) - sum(round(mask_i)*secret_i)` modulo 4096. They can differ due to modulus-switch
rounding: two half-degree masks under secret [1,1] and their exact sum as body have phase zero
but effective rotation degree -1. A127 records both quantities and gates on the exact effective
degree, using the same upstream `pbs_modulus_switch` called by the stock blind rotation.

The completed sweep has21 cell JSONLs,294 exact query records and210 measured
timings. The final driver contains20 newly executed cell records and skips the
earlier N128/16-thread cell, whose driver guard metadata is missing. A128 r12
classifies8 cells as `PRE_POST_GUARD_VALIDATED`,12 as
`POST_CELL_CPU_ABOVE_THRESHOLD`, and1 as `MISSING_DRIVER_METADATA`.
These findings concern timing evidence, not failed FHE outputs.

Original A124 enforces the **pre-cell** idle criterion and child correctness.
It records the post busy value but does not reject it or compare it against15%
(`a124_driver.py:564–580`). Therefore normal sweep exit0 and twelve elevated
post readings are compatible with the original implementation. They must not
be described as twelve failures of A124's enforced post guard; it had no such
rejection step.

A128 subsequently applies the stricter post<=15% criterion
(`tmp/a128-a124-evidence-validation/validate.py:251–255`). Its labels correctly
reflect that later validation rule. This distinction preserves both the
original experiment result and the stronger evidence requirement rather than
retroactively changing what the original PASS meant.

No within-cell background monitor exists. Consequently even the eight
`PRE_POST_GUARD_VALIDATED` cells should be called **pre/post validated**, not
contention-free. The twelve high post cells remain descriptive timings with an
additional guard concern; the missing earlier N128/16 guard cannot be supplied

sources.excerpt:
The useful result is a source-bound address condition. A small decrypted input
error alone does not establish that A126's blind rotation reads a correct pair
of coefficients. Coefficientwise modulus switching must also be included.
The counterexample below is synthetic algebra, not a sampled A44 failure.

The source forms `t=c+6*b3`, using the **positive** raw b3 ciphertext. Before
fusion, four updates have occurred without refresh:

```text
e_c = e_initial + sum(j=0..3) (e_zero_j - e_any_j)
e_input = e_c + 6*e_positive_b3
```

`combine` merges identical ciphertext provenance before applying a triangle
bound. For a generic multi-item case the coefficient L1 is 15; for `N=1`,
`any_j` forwards `zero_j` byte-for-byte, those terms cancel and L1 is 7.
Neither number gives a bound until each remaining error has an independently
justified radius. No unit radius is supplied by this checker. Shared producer
IDs do not make two different sampled ciphertext errors identical.

sources.excerpt:
The new result is stronger than counting 1016→8→4 intermediate GLWE coefficients:
the executable map retains the functional-key family, input row (including the
body), decomposition level and error-polynomial coefficient. It proves an exact
D2 coefficient-norm reduction, exposes cross-lane cancellation, and preserves a
counterexample to assuming that D1 always reduces key-error variance.

Work modulo `q=2^64` in `Z_q[X]/(X^2048+1)`. Let the big-LWE ciphertext for payload
`t` be `a_t=(a_0,...,a_2047,b)` and let `u=(s_0,...,s_2047,-1)`. TFHE's PFKS key
generator includes that final **body row**. For base log `b_dec` and level `l`,
write `g_l=2^(64-b_dec*l)` and retain the exact digits `d_t,i,l` obtained by
`closest_representable(a_t,i)` followed by `decompose(rounded)`.

For a functional polynomial `F`, a key row has phase

```
phase(K_F[i,l]) = u_i * g_l * F + eta_F[i,l](X).
```

Here A127's constant key has `f(1)=-1`, polynomial `-1`, hence effective `F=1`;
its direct key has `f(1)=1`, polynomial `W0`, hence `F=W0`. They are separately
encrypted keys, so their eta atoms have distinct family identities.

Direct-window keys put the desired window into the key-switch output itself. The later A137 three-process D2 gate passed all 24 fixtures; its scalar and convolution controls also passed that sample. D1 goes further: switch right-minus-left, then add left back. A174 passed the fixed 24-fixture progression; each D1 selector uses four PFKS, one ordinary KS, one BR and four samples versus eight PFKS for D2. A151 separately checked one real PFKS aggregate against independently observed key-row errors; that is an identity, not a tail estimate.

In `Z_(2^64)[X]/(X^2048+1)`, PFKS input rounding has
`rho = (round(body)-body) - sum(s_i*(round(a_i)-a_i))`. Actual TFHE decomposition
retains all 2049 rows including the body and its real level order. The observer
checks digit reconstruction of every represented input word. For each retained
PFKS output it recovers the phase and measures

```
E_t(X) = phase(PFKS_t) - (phase(input_t) + rho_t)*F(X).
```

This is the **observed aggregate** `-sum(digit*primitive_key_error)`. It does not
independently decrypt any primitive functional-key row, certify its distribution,
or make residual closure an independent noise measurement. The constant key's
`f=-identity, polynomial=-1` has effective `F=1`; direct has `F=W0`, the signed
width-127 window. The independently encrypted key families have separate hashes.

sources.excerpt:
The missing A135 ingress now has an explicit Rust candidate and a more expensive
control. Both feed the actual A34 tables and a Rust translation of both checked
A135 low-nibble rounds. This is a first composed N4 diagnostic, ending at canonical
survivor flags. It does **not** implement A53 output, a minimal-output service, or
biometric enrollment. It does not establish an extraction noise law or speedup.

The first composed A149 gate failed all four positive variants despite correct native MSBs and exact coefficient-observer closure. Low-amplitude digit errors were amplified in their consumers; some final flags happened to be right, which did not rescue the registered gate. Public rescaling alone was proved a no-op for the relevant error ratio.

A187 changed the premise: direct higher-amplitude consumer digits plus separate lower-amplitude feedback outputs, with explicit joint bounds. It passed first N4. A192’s expansion was invalidated by an observer keyset label bug; A195 fixed only that label, then passed fresh smoke and all 16 N4 fixtures across three fresh keys.

Including exact nearest-integer modulus-switch rounding, the connected error
interval around the set-bit center is [-1409/256,1919/256)Delta. Its native
Delta62 decoding interval [-4,4)Delta lies strictly inside this scalar region.
Consequently a native-correct set bit can exceed the generic open half-Delta
diagnostic and still satisfy every prescribed ideal scalar consumer.

The zero-bit case is different. Its joint degree set wraps as [4032,4095] union
[0,63], giving the connected error interval [-129/256,127/256)Delta. Generic
native Delta62 correctness alone does not ensure this zero-bit consumer. The
small half-degree asymmetry follows from the actual rounding rule and half-open
lookup cells; it must not be silently replaced by a symmetric half-Delta claim.

reconciliation.outcome: Il progetto individua due barriere per separare la pausa del collector dalla lettura terminale successiva a WNOWAIT. Non ha un eseguibile proprio: viene materializzato in A181, la cui sequenza registrata passa.

sources.excerpt:
The next discriminating implementation should add **two explicit barriers**. Sending a notification after WNOWAIT while the collector continues sampling is insufficient: the collector may already have accepted and retained a terminal sample. Reusing that sample would repeat the failed premise.

1. After its last work-stage event, the direct child sends `WORK_COMPLETE` and remains alive on a private control pipe. The parent requests collector quiescence. The collector completes its next scheduled acquisition, persists it, then sends `PAUSED` with its own PID, the bound child PID/birth, sequence and a Mach marker after the acquisition ends. A refusal, unexpected exit, identity mismatch, missing message or deadline ends the gate negatively.
2. The parent verifies that paused receipt while the worker is still held alive. Only then does it release the child's exit. The parent performs exact-child `waitid(WEXITED|WNOWAIT)` and records its returned PID, status and completion marker, followed by the two actual fresh zombie reads. It persists this successful observation before sending a distinct `CAPTURE_TERMINAL` token on the private parent-to-collector pipe.
3. The collector performs **no acquisition while paused**. It accepts the capture token only in that state, with the registered sequence and same child identity. It records token receipt, then takes one new complete acquisition whose begin marker follows receipt. The unchanged A178 terminal predicate still requires prior live identity, two successful equal actual rusage values with expected birth/nonzero exit, and no positive conflicting BSD identity. Actual BSD unavailability remains recorded. Mixed or unstable terminal pairs are not replaced or retried.
